nginx.reason: Astilba follows nginx's stable releases, whose minor version is even. Stable carries mainline's security fixes, so an odd mainline release is not an update.

postgres.reason: Managed PostgreSQL data moves to a later release in place only within one Alpine line, whose ICU (76.1 on 3.23) sorts indexes the same. Alpine 3.24 carries ICU 78.1, so moving lines needs its own recipe (docs/supported-upgrades.md#postgresql-releases).

retired.postgres@sha256:8189a1f6e40904781fc9e261: PostgreSQL 17.10, replaced by 17.12. Databases, backups and upgrade plans made under it still name it, so it stays a known release (services/platform/internal/domain/postgres.go) and the native tests restore and update its data.
retired.postgres@sha256:996d0920e4ff9df1fc19dacb: PostgreSQL 18.4, replaced by 18.7. Databases, backups and upgrade plans made under it still name it, so it stays a known release (services/platform/internal/domain/postgres.go) and the native tests restore and update its data.
